steps.title: Cook the tangzhong
steps.text: Whisk the tangzhong ingredients in a small pot over medium-low heat, stirring until it thickens to a pudding. Cool for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Knead
steps.text: Add everything except the butter to the mixer with the tangzhong. Knead with the dough hook for 8 minutes, add the butter, and knead 8 to 10 more minutes until smooth and stretchy.

steps.title: First rise
steps.text: Cover and let it double.

steps.title: Shape and proof
steps.text: Divide into 3 pieces, roll each flat, fold in thirds, roll up, and place side by side in a greased loaf pan. Proof until the dough crowns the rim.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake until deep golden. Brush with butter and cool on a rack.

steps.title: Knead
steps.text: Combine everything in the mixer and knead with the dough hook for 8 to 10 minutes until smooth.

steps.title: First rise
steps.text: Cover and let it double.

steps.title: Shape and proof
steps.text: Divide into 12 pieces, shape into tight balls, and place in a greased baking dish. Cover and proof until puffy.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake until golden and brush with melted butter while hot.

steps.title: Knead
steps.text: Combine the dough ingredients in the mixer and knead with the dough hook for 6 to 8 minutes until smooth and firm.

steps.title: Rise
steps.text: Cover and let it rise until doubled.

steps.title: Shape
steps.text: Divide into 8 pieces, roll each into a 50 cm rope, and twist into a pretzel shape.

steps.title: Boil
steps.text: Bring the water and baking soda to a boil. Lower in each pretzel for 30 seconds, drain, place on a lined tray, and sprinkle with coarse salt.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake until deep brown.

ingredients.name: toppings: sesame, poppy seeds or everything seasoning

steps.title: Knead
steps.text: Combine the dough ingredients in the mixer. This is a stiff dough, so knead with the dough hook on low for 8 to 10 minutes and stop if the mixer struggles.

steps.title: First rise
steps.text: Cover and let it rise until doubled.

steps.title: Shape
steps.text: Divide into 8 pieces, shape into balls, poke a hole through each, and stretch into rings. Rest on a lined tray.

steps.title: Boil
steps.text: Simmer in water with the honey for 1 minute per side. Drain, then dip in toppings.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake until deep golden brown.

steps.title: Heat the skillet
steps.text: Put a 20 cm cast-iron skillet with 15 g of the butter in the oven while it preheats.

steps.title: Mix
steps.text: Mix the dry ingredients, then stir in buttermilk, eggs and the remaining melted butter just until combined.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Pour into the hot skillet and bake until golden and set in the center.

steps.title: Mix
steps.text: Whisk flour, baking soda and salt. Add the buttermilk and stir with a spatula until a shaggy dough forms.

steps.title: Shape
steps.text: Turn out onto a floured counter and shape into a round about 5 cm thick with minimal handling. Cut a deep cross in the top.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake hot for 15 minutes, then lower the heat and bake until the bottom sounds hollow when tapped.
